item.title: EplayerX 1.2.40
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改善 AIOStreams 播放兼容性，支持需要特定 HTTP 请求头的片源和预览缩略图。 - 修复媒体库中点击服务器卡片有时无法打开的问题，保留拖动排序。 - 修复 iCloud 同步时旧版网盘连接可能消失的问题。网盘授权损坏后，可以重新登录或移除连接。 - 简化资源排序菜单，用图标显示排序方向。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved AIOStreams compatibility for streams and preview thumbnails that require specific HTTP headers. - Fixed an issue where clicking a server card in the library could fail to open it. Drag to reorder remains available. - Fixed an issue where older cloud drive connections could disappear during iCloud sync. You can sign in again or remove a connection if its authorization data is damaged. - Simplified the resource sorting menu and used icons to show sort direction.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
